raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

On ROCm, run the FLUX.3 VAE encode and decode with `torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True` for `quality="exact"` requests. The flag is set only for the duration of the VAE call and restored afterwards. Other platforms and non-exact tiers are unchanged.

## Why

`TestDisaggFlux3Image::test_t2i_and_edit_match_monolithic` has failed on every scheduled PR Test (AMD) rocm10 run since #45309 landed, e.g. [this job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40427865857/job/121938136317): text-to-image matches exactly, but the edit differs in ~57% of pixels (max 22).

The disaggregated path isn't the problem. A monolithic server gives a different edit each time the same request is sent ([diagnostic run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40636143493)). Text embeddings, noise and the prepared reference are bit-identical between runs. The reference's VAE latents are not: 5-9 of 30720 values differ by one bf16 ulp, and the denoiser amplifies that across the image.

Per-module hooks on the VAE alone ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40637699532)) show the first divergence at fp32 `Conv2d` layers whose inputs are identical between runs (`encoder.down.3.block.0.conv1`, `decoder.mid.block_1.conv1`). MIOpen picks a non-deterministic kernel for those shapes. GroupNorm and the attention block are deterministic. Eight repeated calls on MI300X:

| setting | encode distinct outputs | encode time | decode distinct outputs | decode time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| default | 8/8 | 6.6 ms | 8/8 | 13.0 ms |
| `cudnn.deterministic` | 1/8 | 7.1 ms | 1/8 | 13.4 ms |

## Test plan

- [x] PR Test (AMD) `multimodal-gen-test-2-gpu-amd`, rocm10, dispatched on 177e8f74eb: both shards pass, including `TestDisaggFlux3Image` ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40814705814), [shard 0 job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40814705814/job/123253072366)).
- [x] This PR's own PR Test (AMD) run on 177e8f74eb: both rocm10 `multimodal-gen-test-2-gpu-amd` shards pass. `TestDisaggFlux3Image::test_t2i_and_edit_match_monolithic` is PASSED in shard 0, along with the other 3 tests in `test_disagg_server.py` ([job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40814696838/job/123253128252)). The run is red only because of `test_ming_image.py::test_ming_norm_fusion_replay_and_native_fallback` in 1-GPU shard 3, which this change doesn't touch and which passes on main now.
- [x] New unit tests in `test_flux3_image_stages.py` pass in the rocm10 image (10 passed).

nodes.body:
Checked it again and tightened it in 177e8f74eb:

- It now also sets `cudnn.benchmark = False` for the call. With `SGLANG_USE_ROCM_CUDNN_BENCHMARK=1`, benchmark mode picks the conv kernel by timing, which could undo the deterministic choice. This matches the existing deterministic helpers in Sana-WM and MiniMax-H3.
- Both flags are saved and restored in `finally`, so the DiT and other stages keep their settings, including when the VAE call raises.
- It is a no-op unless the request is `quality="exact"` and the platform is ROCm.
- Added unit tests in `test_flux3_image_stages.py` for the ROCm exact case (flags set inside, restored after, also on exception) and for every other platform/tier combination (untouched). They pass on MI355.

The target test passed on rocm10 with the first version; a fresh run on this commit is in progress: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40814705814

 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.validators import (
     VerificationResult,
 )
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import current_platform
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args import ServerArgs
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.logging_utils import init_logger
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.precision import precision_to_dtype
@@ -253,6 +254,29 @@ def denoise_flow_map(
     return packed.data[mode]
 
 
+@contextmanager
+def exact_vae_convolutions(exact: bool):
+    """Keep ``quality="exact"`` bit-reproducible through the VAE on ROCm.
+
+    MIOpen's default fp32 convolution kernels are not run-to-run deterministic
+    for some VAE shapes, so the same reference encodes to slightly different
+    latents on each request. Restrict MIOpen to deterministic kernels for the
+    call, and turn off benchmark mode (``SGLANG_USE_ROCM_CUDNN_BENCHMARK``) so
+    the kernel is not picked by timing. Both flags are restored afterwards;
+    other platforms are unchanged.
+    """
+    if not (exact and current_platform.is_hip()):
+        yield
+        return
+    cudnn = torch.backends.cudnn
+    previous = cudnn.deterministic, cudnn.benchmark
+    cudnn.deterministic, cudnn.benchmark = True, False
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        cudnn.deterministic, cudnn.benchmark = previous
+
+
 def vae_encode(vae, image: Tensor) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
     latent = vae.encode(image.unsqueeze(0).to(next(vae.parameters()).dtype))
     height, width = latent.shape[2:]
@@ -615,6 +639,7 @@ def forward(self, batch: Req, server_args: ServerArgs) -> Req:
                 phase="condition_encode",
             ),
             use_vae_fast_path(self.vae, batch.quality != "exact"),
+            exact_vae_convolutions(batch.quality == "exact"),
         ):
             with torch.inference_mode():
                 batch.extra["flux3_condition"] = encode_references(
@@ -892,6 +917,7 @@ def forward(self, batch: Req, server_args: ServerArgs) -> OutputBatch:
                 phase="decode",
             ),
             use_vae_fast_path(self.vae, batch.quality != "exact"),
+            exact_vae_convolutions(batch.quality == "exact"),
         ):
             with torch.inference_mode():
                 image = crop_output(
@@ -911,6 +937,7 @@ def run_grouped_requests(self, batches, server_args):
                 component_name="vae", module=self.vae, phase="decode"
             ),
             use_vae_fast_path(self.vae, batches[0].quality != "exact"),
+            exact_vae_convolutions(batches[0].quality == "exact"),
         ):
             for group in groups.values():
                 decoded = vae_decode(

@@ -19,6 +19,7 @@
     crop_output,
     denoise_flow_map,
     denoise_packed,
+    exact_vae_convolutions,
     latent_ids,
     load_references,
     noise_tokens,
@@ -247,5 +248,47 @@ def test_cache_dit_runs_only_where_one_forward_covers_a_step(self):
                     self.assertEqual(stage._cache_dit_requested(), sp_size == 1)
 
 
+class TestFlux3ExactVaeConvolutions(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _flags(self):
+        return torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic, torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark
+
+    def _run(self, *, hip: bool, exact: bool, fail: bool = False):
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages import (
+            flux3_image as stages,
+        )
+
+        cudnn = torch.backends.cudnn
+        saved = self._flags()
+        cudnn.deterministic, cudnn.benchmark = False, True
+        try:
+            with mock.patch.object(
+                stages, "current_platform", SimpleNamespace(is_hip=lambda: hip)
+            ):
+                try:
+                    with exact_vae_convolutions(exact):
+                        inside = self._flags()
+                        if fail:
+                            raise RuntimeError("vae failed")
+                except RuntimeError:
+                    pass
+            return inside, self._flags()
+        finally:
+            cudnn.deterministic, cudnn.benchmark = saved
+
+    def test_exact_on_rocm_pins_deterministic_kernels_and_restores(self):
+        for fail in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(fail=fail):
+                inside, after = self._run(hip=True, exact=True, fail=fail)
+                self.assertEqual(inside, (True, False))
+                self.assertEqual(after, (False, True))
+
+    def test_other_tiers_and_platforms_are_untouched(self):
+        for hip, exact in ((True, False), (False, True), (False, False)):
+            with self.subTest(hip=hip, exact=exact):
+                inside, after = self._run(hip=hip, exact=exact)
+                self.assertEqual(inside, (False, True))
+                self.assertEqual(after, (False, True))
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
